purpose: Conservative baseline diagnostic; not flight-strength proof or a converged mesh study
shape_from: validated installed per-part cache matching installed source
load_basis: 1800 g at 6 g, outer panel approximately 35 N and 5.3 Nm about pivot; applying 5.3 Nm plus socket forces is intentionally conservative, not the exact distributed load

result.detail: FEA hub_r: von Mises p99.9 (MPa) vs PETG auto strength / SF 2; peak 63.80 MPa at [222.6, 150.9, 4.7], deflection 11.925 mm (limit 1) at [46.8, 195.0, -1.0], 22606 elements; iterative solver stalled on a 4.00 mm mesh (196347 unknowns); solved exactly on a coarser mesh

limits: Solid CAD analysis does not prove the declared 50% infill print.
Iterative solver stalled and used its built-in coarser exact solve; no mesh convergence study was performed.
The 1 mm displacement target is a diagnostic stiffness target, not an existing project acceptance value.
Geometry is the original 150 mm pivot baseline, not the later 135 mm packaging candidate.
